items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: we added Jesse to the band

ctx.x: And, another time Jesse came over, so I said, well, if he's willing to play for nothing, I say, if there's something in the sight where his money is concerned, I may as well get in there. So, we added Jesse to the band. All right, fine.
He certainly is. So, we went along with the six pieces. And, on until now, we had been done pretty nice. I want to ask you a question.
